source_event.summary: Independent audit found local delivery-state, deduplication and post-outbound state-truth gaps.

generalized_learning.reason: The governing provider-call and conversational-flow skills already require outbound-attempt truth, authenticated callback correlation, persisted state, idempotency and concurrency controls. The escaped defects were local implementation/control-execution omissions; this remediation applies the existing generic rules and records inherited controls rather than introducing issue-specific skill rules.
